reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question by proposing a mechanism (Co removal lowers SFE, shifting deformation from dislocation glide to twinning/DSA) that explains behavior across a broad temperature and strain-rate range, with a clear, controlled comparison to the CoCrFeMnNi baseline and a well-defined falsification experiment. Hypothesis B is too narrow, focusing only on cryogenic twinning, and makes an unjustified quantitative prediction (20–30% twin density increase) without adequate grounding.
